cases.input: Whenever I enter the wrong password, the login form spins and never returns an error. Refreshing fixes it until the next attempt.

expected.probable_cause: The failed-login path may leave the loading state active.
expected.suggested_action: Inspect failed-login handling and verify the loading state is reset.

prediction.probable_cause: Incorrect password input triggers infinite loop.
prediction.suggested_action: Implement proper error handling for invalid passwords.

cases.input: On Firefox, signing in with a valid account always shows 'session expired' even though the password is correct.

expected.probable_cause: Session validation may reject valid credentials in this browser.
expected.suggested_action: Inspect authentication and session-validation logs for the failed sign-in.

prediction.probable_cause: Session expiration logic might not correctly handle valid credentials.
prediction.suggested_action: Review session expiration logic to ensure it properly handles valid passwords.

cases.input: I cannot reproduce the password reset email issue now; it worked yesterday on Windows 11.

expected.probable_cause: The earlier email-delivery failure may have been transient.
expected.suggested_action: Check password-reset delivery logs around the reported failure time.

prediction.probable_cause: Password reset functionality might have been updated or disabled.
prediction.suggested_action: Check if there are any recent changes to the password reset process.

cases.input: Every attempt to sign out on Android 14 returns to the account page, so I remain signed in.

expected.probable_cause: The sign-out flow may not clear the active session.
expected.suggested_action: Inspect the sign-out response and confirm session credentials are cleared.

prediction.probable_cause: Sign-out functionality might not properly handle logout requests.
prediction.suggested_action: Test logout behavior across various scenarios to identify if there's a specific condition causing the issue.

cases.input: The navigation drawer overlaps the page title on an iPad when the screen is narrow.

expected.probable_cause: The narrow-screen layout may not reserve space for the navigation drawer.
expected.suggested_action: Inspect responsive layout rules at the reported tablet viewport.

prediction.probable_cause: Navigation drawer layout might not adjust properly for narrow screens.
prediction.suggested_action: Review and update the navigation drawer's responsive design for narrower screens.

cases.input: Whenever I select dark mode in Safari, the settings panel stays white.

expected.probable_cause: The settings panel may not apply the selected theme state.
expected.suggested_action: Inspect theme propagation to the settings panel in Safari.

prediction.probable_cause: Settings panel color theme setting is not applied correctly.
prediction.suggested_action: Check and update the UI rendering logic related to dark mode settings.

cases.input: The submit button is too close to the form label on the checkout page.

expected.probable_cause: The form spacing may be insufficient.
expected.suggested_action: Review spacing between the checkout label and submit button.

prediction.probable_cause: Form layout design issue causing button proximity to label.
prediction.suggested_action: Review and adjust form layout to ensure proper spacing between elements.

cases.input: On Chrome 129, the modal covers the close icon and I cannot dismiss it without refreshing.

expected.probable_cause: The modal may be positioned above its close control.
expected.suggested_action: Inspect modal stacking and close-control positioning in Chrome 129.

prediction.probable_cause: Modal cover affects accessibility features.
prediction.suggested_action: Review modal design for accessibility compliance.

cases.input: Whenever I request /api/orders with an invalid page number, the service returns a raw stack trace instead of a client error.

expected.probable_cause: The endpoint may not validate pagination parameters before processing them.
expected.suggested_action: Review pagination validation and error-response handling for the orders endpoint.

prediction.probable_cause: Invalid input handling logic for page numbers.
prediction.suggested_action: Review and update the API's input validation rules.

cases.input: All users receive HTTP 503 from the inventory API, and the entire service is unavailable with no workaround.

expected.probable_cause: The inventory service may be unavailable or failing its upstream dependency.
expected.suggested_action: Check inventory service health and upstream dependency status immediately.

prediction.probable_cause: HTTP 503 error indicates service unavailability.
prediction.suggested_action: Check inventory API health and ensure proper logging.

cases.input: The API documentation says this field is optional, but sending a request without it always returns HTTP 400.

expected.probable_cause: Request validation may incorrectly require the documented optional field.
expected.suggested_action: Compare the endpoint schema with its request-validation rules.

prediction.probable_cause: Documentation error indicating the field is required.
prediction.suggested_action: Update the API documentation to reflect that the field is mandatory.

cases.input: Each time I save an order note, the database stores the same note twice.

expected.probable_cause: The save operation may be executed more than once without duplicate protection.
expected.suggested_action: Inspect write-call counts and idempotency handling for order notes.

prediction.probable_cause: Order notes are being saved directly into the database instead of through a proper API endpoint.
prediction.suggested_action: Implement a middleware that validates incoming requests before saving them to the database.

cases.input: The customer search query fails with a missing index error whenever the last-name filter is used.

expected.probable_cause: The query may reference an index that is absent from the database.
expected.suggested_action: Check the deployed indexes and the query plan for the last-name filter.

prediction.probable_cause: The last-name filter requires an index that is not present.
prediction.suggested_action: Add the required index to resolve the missing index error.

cases.input: Customer addresses were permanently deleted for every account during yesterday's migration; no restore is available.

expected.probable_cause: The migration may have removed address records without preserving them.
expected.suggested_action: Stop further migrations and assess backups and data-recovery options.

prediction.probable_cause: Migration process did not properly validate customer addresses.
prediction.suggested_action: Review and update migration scripts to include address validation checks.

cases.input: The report page takes about 25 seconds to load when it contains a year's worth of results.

expected.probable_cause: The report may process or retrieve too much data for a single request.
expected.suggested_action: Profile query time and response size for a one-year report.

prediction.probable_cause: Slow query execution due to large dataset size.
prediction.suggested_action: Optimize query or increase server resources.

cases.input: Every time we open the dashboard, CPU usage reaches 100% and the page becomes unresponsive.

expected.probable_cause: Dashboard rendering or data processing may be consuming excessive CPU.

prediction.suggested_action: Review and optimize the dashboard's codebase for better resource management.

cases.input: Search results are delayed by roughly one second, but the page remains usable.

prediction.probable_cause: Search functionality might have been updated but the delay could be due to network latency.
prediction.suggested_action: Check if there's any recent changes made to the search API or server-side code.

cases.input: Whenever I save the form with a blank email address, the app crashes instead of explaining the required field.

expected.probable_cause: The form may submit a blank email without client-side or server-side validation.
expected.suggested_action: Check required-email validation and handling of empty submissions.

prediction.probable_cause: Form validation logic fails to handle empty email addresses.
prediction.suggested_action: Review and update the validation rules to include empty email addresses.

cases.input: The phone-number field accepts letters even though it says digits only.

expected.suggested_action: Review phone-number validation against the field's documented format.

prediction.probable_cause: Input validation logic incorrectly allows letters.
prediction.suggested_action: Review and update input validation rules for the phone-number field.

cases.input: QA could not reproduce the date validation error on any of their test runs.

expected.suggested_action: Capture the exact date input and environment from the original failure.

prediction.suggested_action: Review input validation logic for date formats.

cases.input: Whenever the payment provider responds with a timeout, our order remains marked pending even though the provider charged the customer.

prediction.suggested_action: Review and update timeout handling logic to distinguish between successful and timed-out responses.

cases.input: The nightly export is missing newly created records because the downstream CRM sync stopped yesterday.

cases.input: An unauthenticated user can read another customer's private invoice by changing the invoice ID in the URL.

prediction.suggested_action: Implement input validation and sanitization for all URL parameters.

cases.input: Someone exploited a remote code execution flaw in the image upload endpoint and is running commands on the server.
